O IMAP Exporter não possui telemetria e:
IMAP Exporter has no telemetry and does not send collected metadata to the developer. Network communication occurs with the configured IMAP server and with addresses you voluntarily open.

The local password is not stored. The IMAP password is saved only in encrypted form and is opened in memory while the account is unlocked. Metadata, settings, and history remain on the user's computer. CSV and ODS files are saved only to the selected location. When you use the lightweight reader, the selected message content is requested from the IMAP server and kept only in the window's memory; it is not saved to the database.

Modified code may behave differently; verify the origin of versions obtained outside the official repository.

IMAP Exporter has no telemetry and does not send collected metadata to the developer. Network communication is made with the configured IMAP server and with addresses that you voluntarily open.

The local password is not stored. The IMAP password is stored only in encrypted form and is opened in memory while the account is unlocked. Metadata, settings, and history remain on the user's computer. CSV and ODS files are saved only to the chosen location. When the lightweight reader is used, the selected message content is requested from the IMAP server and kept only in the window's memory; it is not stored in the database. Attachment analysis stores only names, types, sizes, and IMAP sections. Attachment bytes are requested only when you click Download and are written exclusively to the selected location.

Anyone modifying the source code may change this behavior; verify the origin of versions obtained outside the official repository.
